description: Angular component for configuring key-value map input with validation, including dynamic form controls, custom validators, and integration with Angular forms API.

classes.name: KvMapConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for key-value map configuration with validation and dynamic form controls.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up form group, and subscribes to value changes.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with provided key-value map data.

methods.name: addKeyVal
methods.description: Adds a new key-value pair form group to the form array.

methods.name: removeKeyVal
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair form group at specified index.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs custom validation on the key-value pairs.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the external model based on form value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.
